name: Story Cards Carousel
description: A row of tall cards you scroll sideways; opening one unfolds it into an article.

props.name: items
props.type: { category: string; title: string; src: string; content: ReactNode }[]
props.description: The stories. content is the article shown under the image when a card is open; consecutive paragraphs are spaced for you.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the carousel for assistive technology.

props.name: labels
props.type: { previous?: string; next?: string; close?: string; position?: (first, last, count) => string }
props.description: Text for assistive technology, for translation. position is announced when the row comes to rest.

props.name: backdropBlur
props.description: Blurs the page behind the scrim. Off by default: the browser redraws the blur on every frame while anything behind it changes, which stalls on large pages, most of all in Firefox.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Set --miyuki-story-cards-inset to change the padding at the ends of the row (default 1.5rem). Also accepts every other prop of a section.
